theorem example_thm (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ d₄ d₅ d₆ d₇ : Point) (AB CD AC BD D₁₂ D₂₃ D₁₂D₃ D₄D₅ D₅D₆ D₆D₇ D₇D₄ : Line) (h1 : formParallelogram a b c d₁ AB CD AC BD) (h2 : formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃) (h3 : formTriangle a b c AB (twoLinesIntersectAtPoint AB (twoLinesIntersectAtPoint CD D₁ D₂) a)) (h4 : formTriangle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃) (h5 : distinctPointsOnLine d₁ d₂ D₁₂) (h6 : distinctPointsOnLine d₂ d₃ D₂₃) (h7 : ∠ a:d₁:d₂ = ∟) (h8 : ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ = ∟) : ∃ (d₄ d₅ d₆ d₇ : Point) (D₄D₅ D₅D₆ D₆D₇ D₇D₄ : Line), formParallelogram d₄ d₅ d₆ d₇ D₄D₅ D₅D₆ D₆D₇ D₇D₄ ∧ Triangle.area △ d₄:d₅:d₆ + Triangle.area △ d₅:d₆:d₇ = Triangle.area △ a:b:c := by sorry

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c d e₁ e₂ e₃ : Point) (AB BC CD AD DB E₁₂ E₂₃ : Line), formTriangle a b d AB DB AD ∧ formTriangle b c d BC CD DB ∧ a.opposingSides c DB ∧ formRectilinearAngle e₁ e₂ e₃ E₁₂ E₂₃ ∧ ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃ > 0 ∧ ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃ < ∟ + ∟ → ∃ (f l k m : Point) (FL KM FK LM : Line), formParallelogram f l k m FL KM FK LM ∧ (∠ f:k:m = ∠ e₁:e₂:e₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ f:k:m + Triangle.area △ f:l:m = Triangle.area △ a:b:d + Triangle.area △ d:b:c)
nl_statement: To construct a parallelogram equal to a given rectilinear figure in a given rectilinear angle.Let $ABCD$ be the given rectilinear figure, and $E$ the given rectilinear angle. So it is required to construct a parallelogram equal to the rectilinear figure $ABCD$ in the given angle $E$.  <prf> And since triangle $ABD$ is equal to parallelogram $FH$, and $DBC$ to $GM$, the whole rectilinear figure $ABCD$ is thus equal to the whole parallelogram $KFLM$. Thus, the parallelogram $KFLM$, equal to the given rectilinear figure $ABCD$, has been constructed in the angle $FKM$, which is equal to the given (angle) $E$.
